description: Hand-labeled offline retrieval fixture for FinSight's hybrid retriever.

chunks.text: Black Scholes prices European call and put options using spot strike maturity risk free rate dividend yield and implied volatility.
Value at Risk VaR estimates a portfolio loss quantile while CVaR expected shortfall averages losses beyond the VaR threshold.
Markowitz mean variance optimization selects portfolio weights from expected returns and a covariance matrix along an efficient frontier.
Walk forward validation trains only on past observations and measures classifier signal quality with ROC AUC on the next chronological fold.
Hybrid retrieval combines semantic vector similarity with BM25 keyword ranking to find relevant document chunks for a question.
Free cash flow equals operating cash flow less capital expenditures and supports valuation and liquidity analysis.
Central bank interest rate cuts can lower discount rates while inflation and employment influence monetary policy decisions.
Option Greeks include delta gamma vega theta and rho, sensitivities to spot curvature volatility time decay and interest rates.
Bid ask spread market depth and trading volume are common indicators of market liquidity and transaction cost.
Credit analysis evaluates leverage interest coverage debt maturity and default risk for a corporate borrower.
